text:
Mia Chen: dropping a compact prototype for the Usage & Billing card. trying to fit org context + top projects + token snapshot in one tile. mock: https://drive.redwood/compact-usage-v2.png :card_index:
Devon Patel: looks tight. can we keep token rows visible without expand? platform teams need model costs at a glance
Raja Iyer: inline micro-table: Model | Tokens | USD, max 3 rows then overflow. sparkline above for trend
Sasha L: if toggle for org/project is at top, add a tiny breadcrumb like [Org: Redwood Inc] so users don't lose context
Olivia Park: accessibility: micro-table text low contrast, currently failing WCAG AA at 14px. also chart controls need keyboard focus states
Mia Chen: will bump contrast to >=4.5:1 and add focus outlines. thinking invoice CTA becomes icon-only under 480px to save space
Eli (PM): prefer icon + sr-only label or tooltip on mobile; support has reports of missed download affordance with icon-only
Devon Patel: compact tradeoff: sparkline hides per-model spikes. stacked area shows composition but uses more vertical space
Raja Iyer: proposal: density toggle. default compact = sparkline + inline tokens. expanded = stacked area with legend. keep default compact
Sasha L: copy tweak: change "Token Breakdown" -> "Token cost by model" for clarity
Olivia Park: change aria-labels from "usage-chart" to "monthly spend and token cost by model"
Mia Chen: will update Figma and push changes. quick tooltip schema: {"Model":"string","Tokens":"number","Cost":"string"}
Eli (PM): priorities for next release: 1) micro-table contrast to AA, 2) clear invoice CTA (mobile friendly), 3) persist date range when switching org/project. density toggle and modal overflow can be next sprint
Devon Patel: UX nit: do not reset date range when switching scope; users find that disorienting
Raja Iyer: for org-level with many projects, show top 3 projects + "show more" that opens a small modal (focus trap, accessible close)
Sasha L: modal accessibility checklist: trap focus, initial focus on first interactive element, Escape closes, close button has aria-label
Olivia Park: invoice filename request for accounts: <org-slug>-YYYY-MM-invoice.csv, e.g., redwood-inc-2025-03-invoice.csv
Mia Chen: thanks all, I'll post updated frames with contrast fixes, breadcrumb chip, icon-CTA tooltip, and sticky date range when ready :white_check_mark:
